title: Why Vultures Circled Leaking Gas Pipelines
subject: turkey vulture

scenes.text: Gas workers kept finding vultures circling over leaking pipelines. Why?
Natural gas has no smell, so companies add a chemical called ethyl mercaptan to make leaks stink.
Ethyl mercaptan is also a key ingredient in the smell of rotting meat.
Turkey vultures can pick up that smell at a few parts per trillion.
In the late 1950s, ornithologist Kenneth Stager built a mercaptan machine and proved vultures find food by smell.
A Union Oil worker had noticed it first. The vultures weren't lost. They were following their noses.

description:
